w2:textbox.label: Pass Parameters when Setting Source Screen

1. Enter the parameters to pass when creating a tab in the InputBox below.
2. Click the setSrc() button.
3. Confirm the screen is set to the source. (The parameters entered above are also passed.)
4. Click the $p.getParameter() button on the generated tab screen.
5. Confirm that the parameter entered above (passed when setting the source) is displayed.
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)
